notes.title: Public update 2025-08-17
notes.notes:
We’ve updated the in-game documentation:  

– Added Ukrainian version of README.  

– Removed outdated Russian version.  

This is a minor maintenance update and does not affect gameplay or save files.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.902.4379
Release Date of Chapter Three
notes.notes:
Hi, Foxies! Here’s the long-awaited news!

FoxTail’s Chapter Three releases on May 7!
Explore the delightful world of music and sounds.
Find out what secret hides an old, abandoned manor.
And get ready to meet new, unexpected friends.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.527.3389
Discount before the release of the 2nd Chapter
notes.notes:
Hi, Foxies!
Just in a few days you’ll be able to continue enjoying Leah’s adventures: the second chapter of FoxTail will be released on January 17th. From January 13 till January 16 anyone who has long wanted to play FoxTail will be able to get it at a 50% discount! After this the price will be raised.

Have a nice game! We can’t wait to show you the second chapter of FoxTail.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31593932/d3e7420a46f6cf49b689b6db833b345424915cb1.png

notes.title: Update 1.2.304.1571
Update 1.2.304.1571
Announcement of the first HUGE patch
notes.notes:
Hello, foxies! Thank you very much for such a warm welcome, high-quality and sincere feedback.

For the whole 14 days after the release we were communicating with you and carefully studying your feedback. During this time the game has greatly changed for the better. Thanks to you in the first days we’ve released a few small patches fixing critical errors. We’re so delighted there were very few of them, and we managed to quickly switch from corrections to improvements.

Expect in the coming days a big patch that improves game performance, interface, hints and puzzle logic.

Warning! The new version of the game will not support old saves, because the game will have a lot of changes, including new texts, reactions, phrases, and graphics.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31593932/5a74469ddddea4539447a6fc2cb84474624ed717.gif
